vertexAiChat.projectId.description: Required. GCP Project ID used with Google Agent Platform, both for direct Vertex calls and when a proxy is configured (it is forwarded to the proxy). Models and regions are auto-discovered.

vertexAiChat.proxyUrl.description: Optional. Enterprise proxy base URL for centralized metrics, policies and business logic (HTTPS; loopback HTTP for local testing). Uses your personal gcloud auth login identity and a server-controlled model catalog. When set, requests go to the proxy with no direct fallback; when empty, requests go directly to Vertex. Configure in user settings, not workspace settings.

vertexAiChat.modelDiscoveryTimeoutSecond.description: Maximum time in seconds for each model endpoint's discovery attempts and retry delays, after it leaves the queue. Unresponsive endpoints are skipped; rate-limited endpoints remain available. Applies to the next discovery; run Refresh Models after changing this setting.

vertexAiChat.retryMaxDurationMinutes.description: Maximum retry duration in minutes for transient API failures such as 429 or 503.

vertexAiChat.enableUserLabel.description: Include a user identifier as a 'vscode-vertex-ai-user' label in Gemini and Claude calls. Values are sanitized to meet GCP label requirements. Requests are blocked before inference if no valid custom or automatic value can be resolved.

vertexAiChat.userLabelValue.description: Custom value for the user label. If empty, the value is derived from the active identity. Use a stable non-sensitive identifier where possible. Values are automatically sanitized to meet GCP label requirements.

vertexAiChat.enableProjectLabel.description: Include the current VS Code project name as a 'vscode-vertex-ai-project' label in Gemini and Claude calls. Values are sanitized to meet GCP label requirements. Requests are blocked before inference if no valid custom or automatic value can be resolved.

vertexAiChat.projectLabelValue.description: Custom value for the project label. If empty, the workspace name is derived automatically. Use a stable low-cardinality value. Values are automatically sanitized to meet GCP label requirements.

vertexAiChat.hideBillingWarning.description: Hide the Estimated Costs warning banner on the Usage Dashboard.

vertexAiChat.commitMessagePrompt.description: Custom system prompt used for AI commit message generation. If empty, the default Conventional Commits prompt is used.

vertexAiChat.commitMessageModel.description: Model ID used for AI commit-message generation. Defaults to Gemini 3 Flash. Configure it in user, workspace, or folder settings, or use Select Commit Message Model. The model must be available in the current catalog when generating; an empty or unavailable selection produces an error without choosing another model.

vertexAiChat.thinkingEffortByModel.description: Thinking effort for public language-model requests, by model ID. Available values depend on the current catalog and backend. Internal commit-message generation keeps its configured model behavior.
